title: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for English-Swedish Medical Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.28050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models do well on English medical exams, but less is known about Swedish. This matters most for small open models that hospitals can run locally. To reduce this gap, we first build an item-aligned English-Swedish benchmark from ten medical multiple-choice datasets; each Swedish item keeps the options and answer of its English source. A conservative refinement loop repairs the translations: open models from three families find errors, ground them in a Swedish medical term base, and keep a model-written edit only if blind judges vote for it. On this benchmark, small models lose much more accuracy in Swedish than large ones, especially when they answer without reasoning. Second, we ask whether English data and open teacher models can close this gap. translated_title: 面向英语-瑞典语医学问答的大语言模型基准测试与适配
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在英语医学考试中表现出色，但其在瑞典语上的表现却鲜为人知，而这对医院可在本地部署的小型开源模型尤为重要。为了缩小这一差距，我们首先基于十个医学选择题数据集构建了一个条目对齐的英语-瑞典语基准测试，其中每个瑞典语条目都保留其英语源条目的选项和答案。我们采用一个保守的迭代优化流程来修复翻译：由来自三个家族的开源模型查找错误，将其锚定于瑞典语医学术语库进行验证，且只有在盲评裁判投票通过的情况下才保留模型撰写的修改。在该基准上，小型模型在瑞典语上的准确率损失远大于大型模型，尤其是在不作推理直接作答的情况下。其次，我们探究英语数据和开源教师模型能否弥合这一差距：我们翻译训练数据，让教师模型撰写推理轨迹，并在金标准答案或推理轨迹上，以英语、瑞典语或双语形式微调两个小型学生模型。在推理轨迹上训练（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文构建了首个条目对齐、经保守翻译优化流程校验的英语-瑞典语医学选择题基准，发现小型开源模型在瑞典语上准确率显著下降，并证明利用翻译数据与开源教师模型生成的推理轨迹进行微调可有效弥合这一语言差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an item-aligned English-Swedish medical multiple-choice benchmark refined by a conservative translation-correction loop, shows that small open models suffer much larger accuracy drops in Swedish than large ones, and demonstrates that fine-tuning on translated data and teacher-generated reasoning traces can effectively close this language gap.
